integration_instructions: Root researches only the six records marked owner=root; the read-only Luna evidence reviewer assesses only its four disjoint records and returns findings without editing files or researching overlapping models.

For every field inspect the exact attempt and accepted sources before new web research. Use exact-model current primary evidence for current facts; do not infer a precise weight, full BOM, trim, material grade, or stiffness score.

Integrate a catalog value only when an attributable source directly supports that exact model and field. If a previously found value is already integrated, add a dated source-reuse resolution naming the source and preserving its caveats. If the prior finding is insufficient or ambiguous, keep it unresolved with a precise reason and reopen trigger.
Do not add images unless exact product identity, documented reusable rights, credit, alt text, and fallback are all established. Do not make external GitHub changes.
done_criteria: Assess all 20 frozen fields, integrate verified direct evidence or record a specific unresolved disposition, write a results matrix, run research:check and coverage:accept if ledgers/catalog change, run npm run check once for this coherent batch, run npm run image:report only if image records change, and inspect final diff and batch JSON validity.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
